_read_me: Pivot-or-persevere thresholds for the Oct 6 presentation, applied by `python -m tools.midterm_decision`. Change a number ONLY in a reviewed PR, and never after seeing the result it decides.
honesty_note: The model and safety thresholds were written down AFTER the Session 5 results were seen (we missed the pre-registration step in docs/north_star.md). The user thresholds were written BEFORE any user test was run. Say this on the decision slide.

model.rule: the deployed run beats every baseline: paired-bootstrap 95% CI of the macro-F1 difference entirely above 0

safety.rule: false-SUPPORT rate of the deployed run on SciFact dev is at or below the ceiling
safety.why_this_number: about 1 in 7 non-supporting claims called SUPPORTS; the word-overlap baseline is at 0.222

users.rule: at least min_participants outside users; at least min_t1_success_participants got every T1 task right without help; no participant agreed with a wrong verdict more than max_misled times in total
